title: 第19章 快速提升第20章 功成需氪金
slug: 从暮年娶妻到长生不死
lines: 沈云尝试完毕，专属福报没全部用完。
过犹不及，一天一次正好。
迫不及待的掏出段式符斋送的那本书翻起来。
“《气血凝丝诀》先看看容不容易入门。”烛光下老人吃力的翻阅书籍。
这并不是功法，只是一种使用技巧。
在圣城，功法不是什么店都能售卖！
前五页，讲述了法诀正文，后面二十页全是感悟技巧。
这起初只是入阶后气血透体的技巧，后来被人完善，成了一门上佳的辅修法诀。
修行起来很简单。
引导气血在脉络中运转凝结便是入门。
沈云一边翻看感悟，一边根据法诀引导气血在经脉流转，这种法诀都是易学难精。
入门简单。
很快，古卷便有了反应。
【气血凝丝诀（入门110）】
脉络微凝，入门成功。
入门之后沈云继续习练。
一个时辰后。
【气血凝丝诀（入门1010）】
“如果呼吸法也这么简单就好了。”
沈云算了算，不到十分钟涨一点熟练度，无非耗费些时间。
他之前没有刻意练习过对气血的掌控，现在感受气血在经脉中越发凝实，很有帮助。
入门后瓶颈向来难以跨越。
不过挡不住沈云。
福报。
【气血凝丝诀（掌控1100）】
瞬间，沈云气血的操纵有了一个提升，气血更精准的被他把握，经脉中较为顺畅地运行。
透体而出的气血，能简单收束形状，更加凝实。
“还不错。”
沈云满意的点了点头。
【进境飞速九窍舒，福报+2】
古卷波动，沈云为之一怔，不知不觉已经修行到了凌晨。
这种能够随时看到自己进步的感觉让他欲罢不能。
熬夜修行也是享受的一种。
看向窗外高悬的明月，夜深了。
一时忘了时间。
“熬夜减寿，早些睡觉吧。”
content_en:
Shen Yun finished trying, but not all the exclusive blessings were used up.
Too much is never enough, once a day is just right.
He couldn't wait to take out the book Duan Shifuzhai gave him and flip through it.
"Let's see if it's easy to get started with "The Secret of Qi and Blood Condensing Silk"." The old man struggled to read through the books under the candlelight.
This is not a skill, just a technique.
In the Holy City, not all stores can sell exercises!
The first five pages describe the main text of the method, and the next twenty pages are all about comprehension techniques.
At first, this was just a skill for qi and blood to penetrate the body after entering the level. Later, it was perfected and became an excellent supplementary technique.
It is very simple to practice.
Guiding Qi and blood to circulate and condense in the veins is the beginning.
While Chen Yun was reading through his insights, he guided the flow of Qi and blood in the meridians according to the magic formula. This kind of magic formula is easy to learn but difficult to master.
Getting started is easy.
Soon, the ancient scrolls responded.
[Qi and Blood Silk Condensation Technique (Introduction 110)]
The veins are slightly condensed, and the entry is successful.
After getting started, Shen Yun continued to practice.
An hour later.
[Qi and Blood Silk Condensation Technique (Introduction 1010)]
"If only breathing techniques were this simple."
Shen Yun did the math and found that gaining a little proficiency in less than ten minutes was just a waste of time.
He had never deliberately practiced controlling qi and blood before, and now it was very helpful to feel the qi and blood becoming more solid in his meridians.
The bottleneck after entry has always been difficult to overcome.
But he couldn't stop Shen Yun.
Blessing.
[Qi and Blood Silk Condensation Technique (Control 1100)]
Instantly, Chen Yun's control of Qi and blood was improved. He could grasp Qi and blood more accurately, and his meridians ran more smoothly.
The Qi and blood flowing out of the body can easily tighten the shape and become more solid.
"Not bad."
Shen Yun nodded with satisfaction.
[Entering the country quickly, Jiuqiaoshu, good fortune +2]
The ancient scroll fluctuated, and Shen Yun was startled. Unknowingly, he had already practiced until early in the morning.
This feeling of being able to see his progress at any time made him want to stop.
Staying up late to practice is also a form of enjoyment.
Looking at the bright moon hanging high outside the window, it is late at night.
For a moment I forgot the time.
"Stay up late to shorten your life, go to bed earlier."
